title: Offensive Language Detection in Under-resourced Algerian Dialectal Arabic Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of classifying offensive and abusive language in Algerian Arabic using standard machine learning and deep learning models (SVM, NB, CNN, BiLSTM). While it mentions that religion is a topic found in the social media comments within its dataset, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
